svg.title: One manual login, a local vault
svg.desc: A manual login reaches a private local vault through CDP. Exact-host lookup submits through the Ruin executor. Cookie and Web Storage snapshots survive a browser restart.
svg.text: A / Capture the submit, keep it local
B / The next selected Ruin task
No credential? The active task waits for manual login.
After the form clears, continue the original task.
C / Restore the next Chrome session
Background CDP work leaves the OS foreground alone.
A saved login is not an application receipt.
HTTPS only · private local files · no credentials in agent output
